item.description: Taiwan’s main opposition Kuomintang (KMT) faces an uphill battle in Saturday’s local elections, with its goal of retaining 15 local administrations looking increasingly difficult to achieve. item.title: Southeast Asia’s rice farmers are being squeezed. Your wallet could be next
item.description: For more than three decades, Andrew Lim has watched rice farmers in the Malaysian agricultural town of Sekinchan rely on familiar weather patterns to know when to plant their crops. But increasingly unpredictable rainfall and extreme heat are making it harder for farmers to get their timing right, with devastating consequences for their livelihoods. Lim, who runs a rice mill, said farmers were now harvesting just four to five tonnes of unmilled rice each season, compared with 10 tonnes two years...
